entries.title: Authentication 5xx after a release
entries.excerpt: Synthetic runbook: if login begins returning HTTP 500 immediately after a release, declare an access incident, collect the release version and affected environment, then route the incident to Engineering.

entries.title: VPN failure after certificate rotation
entries.excerpt: Synthetic runbook: if remote VPN tunnels fail immediately after a certificate rotation, collect the gateway name and certificate expiry, then route to Network Engineering.

entries.title: Invoice PDF export timeout
entries.excerpt: Synthetic runbook: if invoice PDF export jobs time out, capture the job ID and tenant, then route to Billing Platform.

entries.title: Outbound email delay
entries.excerpt: Synthetic runbook: if outbound email is delayed, inspect the SMTP queue depth and password-reset templates, then route to Messaging.

entries.title: SSO MFA loop
entries.excerpt: Synthetic runbook: if users loop on SSO MFA after an IdP change, collect the Okta policy name and affected application, then route to Identity.
